w: Swamishri was honored by the President of Botswana, H.E. Festus G. Mogae, at the State House. Swamishri blessed him and the country for progress and success. The President said his country allowed freedom of worship and he was honored to welcome him.

At 6.25pm Swamishri addressed an assembly of doctors offering honorary services in the mandir, "Our shastras say that one who has self-control suffers less diseases. Because when man does not exercise any discipline in eating, drinking, looking, hearing, etc. And the unseen elements (of anger, jealousy, greed, lust) within are more responsible for his sufferings. They cannot be detected by a stethoscope. The shastras prescribe refuge in God as the only cure. The more self-control one has the more peace and happiness one will have in life. And along with self-control one should also associate with a holy sadhu (sant samagam). Prayers too have cured chronic diseases..."

Prasad Pravesh & Kalash Vidhi To begin the inauguration of the second traditional Hindu mandir in America, Swamishri performed the Prasad Pravesh, or the first official entry into the mandir, and kalash pujan vidhi after completing his morning puja.
